title: Step 2 - recall: the stack from memory
intro: There is no ghost text and nothing turns red.
It needs a generic `Stack[T any]` backed by a slice,
whose zero value is an empty stack, with:
- `Pop() (T, bool)`, which removes and returns the top,
or the zero value and false when empty, and sets the
vacated slot to the zero value;
- `Peek() (T, bool)`, the top without removing it;
- `Len() int`, how many values it holds.
A hidden test checks that a popped pointer is freed.
Press `<F6>` to submit: `go vet` and the step's hidden
tests decide. If they fail, fix it and submit again.
